AFTER regularises 보조용언 spacing ("계산해주는" → "계산해 주는") but norm-auxiliary-verb-spacing states both joined and spaced forms are permitted, and AFTER is not itself internally consistent about it ("바꿔놓았어" stays joined) -- the evaluation records this as churn, not a defect either way, so PASS holds on both drafts.
"Nothing changed on any dimension" per the evaluation's own summary for this pair; e.g. AFTER's "질문 하나를 더 던지는 것 자체가 시간과 돈이 드는 일이었어." only loses BEFORE's bold emphasis.
No genre-relevant change between BEFORE and AFTER was identified in this pair.
BEFORE already opened concrete-first -- "너희 반에서 학급 문고 예산을 짜다고 생각해보자. '책을 3권 더 사면 얼마가 남을까?'" -- before any mention of 표 계산 프로그램, so aud-concrete-before-abstract had nothing left to repair in AFTER.

The draft contains no domain-specific canonical terminology requiring retention or aliasing; it is child-register prose about a general concept (tools shaping work), not a piece carrying a canonical technical vocabulary the way the bonds/housing drafts carry 국채/신용스프레드 or 착공/준공.

No human has expressed a preference on this draft or any of the fifteen drafts read by the SUE-604 evaluation; editorial/voice.md records the voice, not a verdict on this text. Silence is not acceptance.

notes: Transcribed from sue604-evaluation.md §2.3: "Nothing changed on any dimension. This is the honest result and it matters for §4." The auxiliary-verb-spacing edit is recorded as churn the pack itself warns against flagging as an error, not as a fix or a defect. Comparative dimensions abstain: not assessed by the source evaluation. comparison.mode is "abstain" and outcome is ABSTAIN where no language dimension failed: the evaluation this record transcribes assessed only the seven absolute language_quality dimensions and made no comparative judgement against a reference on any of the five comparative axes. Recording mode "pairwise" would assert a comparison that never happened, and a comparative PASS would claim the draft was measured against the reference and held up. The references are still named because they were the genre-matched pool available and a later comparative pass should use them.
